searchText: https://github.com/eth-clients/hoodi/blob/db5bfa8c65caeef23afa225797167e956477a3ee/metadata/config.yaml#L96 not sure we want `GOSSIP_MAX_SIZE` or `MAX_CHUNK_SIZE`, there was a PR to change it to `MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE` and removed `MAX_CHUNK_SIZE` https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4045 This needs to be changed for all testnets not just hoodi well, we can add more bad config, or we can fix it to the current spec... sure, I am just saying it needs to be fixed for all rather than just 1 of them. We can't support 2 different configs for different testnets. The spec config needs to be consistent across all networks. Otherwise we can't add hoodi in as a new network in prysm this is precisely why i didnt want to rename global config items, just saying so im not sure how we ever 'fix' the name, because compatibility What do you guys want us to do? Rename or keep both around? We have limited time before genesis, and would like to do this pre genesis rather than post. cc: all cl teams <@680234424037670912> <@476250636548308992> i think no one else (other than attestant) might have setup nodes. So if we act now we could make the change (also fix min validator count while we're at it) The config as it is, is fine for us right now. Just that if we want to add in `MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE` and remove the deprecated ones it would cause issues. And since that's something we have to do in sepolia/mainnet anyway there's no point changing it just for hoodi? I already have a PR open for holesky and sepolia. It hasnt been merged yet which is why we cant switch prysm to the new format https://github.com/eth-clients/holesky/pull/118 https://github.com/eth-clients/sepolia/pull/97 I think we should use the new format and merge in the other two outstanding prs too We are indeed running nodes, so if any changes are made that require us to reset please let me know. lgtm, merged the max_payload things <@476250636548308992> could you make the change for hoodi too? sure thing, will open a PR in a few mins https://github.com/eth-clients/hoodi/pull/5 We only support the new values so our config just pretends like it has the old one when it generates a remote spec. this isn't a deal breaker for us, its just a note for future us, that renaming config items should be discouraged because its tedious to ever get propagated... If the new configs come out thats great, as long as the rest of the CL teams can change them if they haven't already... I had just kind of expected new networks would be on the current spec fields. Missing mainnet would be frustrating because the next good chance is likely at fulu. <@586161934425128960> would it be okay to merge this PR in? with the `MIN_GENESIS_ACTIVE_VALIDATOR_COUNT`, apologies for flipping on the topic over the weekend. I think since we had to change other values it seemed prudent to also change this, else we'd have left it alone also cc <@219015859182632960> and <@144468805697929216> about the value change since there might be releases/etc no I think this is a good change to do, there might be people running v1.28.0-rc.0 which is why I was worried but I don't think it matters, already opened a PR to adapt the value in Lodestar https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/7594 this PR change to the config.yaml has been merged: https://github.com/eth-clients/hoodi/pull/5 No luck so far. I'm still looking for someone who collected more blocks than the canonical chain during holesky non-finality. I just need blocks, no need for states. <@755590043632140352> do I understand correctly that you got those blocks? Yeah Sam uploaded them, I'll DM you Accept my friend request though We are still missing input some teams. If you haven't submitted anything, please don't hesitate https://pad.ethereum.org/form/#/2/form/view/5tTG6KqXKea87LR2BDha7QzCpDxwmYGEtKTcmFeju0Q/ Will send besu response tomorrow APAC time, collecting some feedback from other timezones first We have a few teku nodes running hoodi on ARM (in a cloud virtualized env), they seem to be using more resources than other clients on similar infra. <@755590043632140352> was mentioning it could be due to crypto libs being used and ARM, not a bug - so won't tag the team. But it probably makes sense to look at before mainnet. ARM should be very much well supported. Risc V is a bigger issue though I'd take a look at the JVM's hashing algo on ARM <@680234424037670912> is anyone using RISC-V in a production capacity as an Ethereum node? my understanding is most RISC-V stuff is deeply embedded (Nvidia etc) or Raspberry Pi-type boards or etc <@866046126279884851> would know, I think they do run and promote Risk V for production I think gballet tried once and gave up 😅 I mean, I hope it is, Nimbus has definitely accepted various PRs to try to get RISC-V working and people do report success, albeit it's apparently slow so I'm for it i think he gave up on CL compiling to it but was able to get geth to compile bazel strikes again lodestar's limitations were that the recent stable nodejs versions were not yet available on the riscv arch another issue that I felt when I was looking into this was that riscv commodity machines were costly and underwhelming compared to whats general commodity hardware out there Hoodi is live and finalizing ❤️ https://dora.hoodi.ethpandaops.io/ https://hoodi.ethpandaops.io/ It would be great if client teams can make releases so we can push for all the tooling to come up. Hoodi is live and finalizing ❤

excerpts.author: .paulharris
excerpts.content:
We only support the new values so our config just pretends like it has the old one when it generates a remote spec. this isn't a deal breaker for us, its just a note for future us, that renaming config items should be discouraged because its tedious to ever get propagated...
If the new configs come out thats great, as long as the rest of the CL teams can change them if they haven't already... I had just kind of expected new networks would be on the current spec fields. 
Missing mainnet would be frustrating because the next good chance is likely at fulu.
